# PurelyCleaningServices

> Trusted, vetted home cleaning service based in Dubai, UAE. Same cleaner assigned to every recurring visit, eco-friendly and non-toxic products used as standard, transparent pricing with no hidden fees.

PurelyCleaningServices offers residential home cleaning across Dubai, covering studios, apartments, townhouses, and villas.

## Services
- Regular Cleaning: weekly or bi-weekly recurring home maintenance
- Deep Cleaning: thorough top-to-bottom cleaning
- Holiday Home Turnover: fast cleaning between short-term rental guests
- Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning: handover-ready cleaning for tenants and landlords
- Post-Renovation Cleaning: dust and debris removal after construction or renovation work

## Recurring Plans
Weekly, fortnightly, twice-weekly, and monthly recurring cleaning plans are available, each with the same assigned cleaner every visit.

## Key facts
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Coverage area: all of Dubai
- Booking method: WhatsApp
- Differentiators: same cleaner every visit, eco-friendly products included as standard, transparent pricing with no hidden fees
- Website: https://purelycleaningservices.com

## Contact
Booking and enquiries are handled via WhatsApp through the website.
